parts.name: foam-cap-top
parts.model_overhangs_review: This exact final Mark2 +Z/floor-down top-cup slice contains no support bodies or interface islands. The 14.6 mm cup walls, attachment/conduit columns and four G Ganen mount columns rise from the bedded floor. The cup mouth and insert bores face upward; screw/conduit bores pass vertically through the floor. There is no enclosed supported cavity to clean. The flat lid-bearing rim/column tops, complete floor and bores retain their exported profiles. Zero support is the new slice measurement, not a physical warping, insert-fit or strength claim.

native_log_diagnostics_review: The only three diagnostics name inherited profile commands: startup hotend-type detection T1001 and end-code control/unload T65535/T65279. These are recorded parser messages for those authored machine-code blocks. The native slice returned0, has no plate warning and retains the verified intended filament/nozzle mapping; it emits no separate geometry diagnostic.
review_scope: The exact final Mark2 top-cap archive only. Raw zero-support readings and null build-up fields are retained; no H2C alternative approval is inherited. Physical fit and cleanup remain unmeasured.
